rationale: The plan matches the design: an unpaired 3-vs-3 single-batch comparison with DESeq2 Wald on ~condition (control as reference, named contrast), median-of-ratios inside the model, a minimal justified filter, BH at 0.05, apeglm shrinkage, lfcThreshold rather than post-hoc cutoffs, and an explicit low-power statement; the edgeR QL overlap is an added robustness layer rather than a substitute. QC is complete (blind VST, PCA, distances, library sizes, colored by condition) with a stated no-drop-without-technical-reason policy. Enrichment correctly states that no curated zebrafish collection exists, runs fgsea on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list with a 15-500 size window, uses a babelgene ortholog map with mapped share and one-to-one losses reported, and names the WikiPathways release, though the ortholog table version itself is not explicitly pinned. The report section is thorough but names the Ensembl identifier space without stating the Ensembl release number.
